text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Hatsuratsu? Are you not here? Hatsuratsu—

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
So you were hiding under the playground 
equipment... It's dangerous down there, 
come on out.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I told you to come out, not to jump right 
at me.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"Honestly... Even that rambunctious side 
of yours is just like Tome-san's dog, 
Hatsuratsu."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Grooming me, are you? Fufu, I shall stroke 
your head in return.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Fluff, fluff... Hatsuratsu is so soft. I 
feel like I could pet him forever...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Shoot, it's already night...! I'll have to 
cancel today's voluntary training.
